items.text: Gates now open opposite direction and have updated bounds, improving placement and functionality.
New sandbag variations are now unlockable via the original/BP button.
Ferry terminal now contains a functional, powered loot room.
Honey bandage added to the primitive and hardcore tech trees.
Halloween and Easter door wreaths now deploy and can be picked up correctly.
Server stall caused by a dtRaycast infinite loop fixed, improving overall server stability.
Arrows shot from bows now correctly hide on the server, removing lingering arrow meshes.
Adjusted placeholder crafting costs to more reasonable values, improving early‑game resource planning.
Wood fences now provide protection comparable to stone walls, improving defensive capability.
Fences and related prefabs now have correct collision, allowing them to block movement and projectiles properly.
Added missing socket and validation checks on gates, restoring proper gate operation.

2026-09-08.summary:
### Base Building
- Gates now open opposite direction and have updated bounds, improving placement and functionality.
- New sandbag variations are now unlockable via the original/BP button.

### Monuments & Loot
- Ferry terminal now contains a functional, powered loot room.

### Items & Crafting
- Honey bandage added to the primitive and hardcore tech trees.

### Events
- Halloween and Easter door wreaths now deploy and can be picked up correctly.

### Stability
- Server stall caused by a dtRaycast infinite loop fixed, improving overall server stability.

### Visual Bugs
- Arrows shot from bows now correctly hide on the server, removing lingering arrow meshes.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Adjusted placeholder crafting costs to more reasonable values, improving early‑game resource planning.
- Wood fences now provide protection comparable to stone walls, improving defensive capability.
- Fences and related prefabs now have correct collision, allowing them to block movement and projectiles properly.

### Structures & Mechanics
- Added missing socket and validation checks on gates, restoring proper gate operation.

items.text: Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.
Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.
Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.
Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.
Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

2026-09-07.summary:
### Animals & Livestock
- Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
- Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

### Weapons & Attachments
- Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
- Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

### Building & UI
- Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

items.text: Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.
Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.
Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.
Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.

2026-09-06.summary:
### UI & Quality of Life
- Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.

### Stability
- Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.

### Items & Equipment
- Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.
